items.finding: The owner's message is not stored verbatim in this checkout. The shared urgency and parallel-run paragraphs are copied verbatim from the family prompt preserved in GEMSDOE63/README.md; the lane paragraph and family-brief bullets are reproduced from this session's record and may differ in wording.
items.handling: Disclosed at the top of PROMPT.md and README.md; every requirement is carried.

items.finding: The brief cites 0.3195 and 0.3774 as the high marks. The public leaderboard fetched on 2026-10-12 shows #1 = 0.4275 (xiaofanhu), #2 = 0.3585; 0.3195 is rank 9 (DARD).
items.handling: Live snapshot saved (registry/leaderboard_snapshot_2026-10-12.json) and used for all board context.

items.finding: The 0.2778 attributed to GEMSDOE32 h33-2-b2 has no organizer receipt linking it to the file bytes. The value appears on the public board under participant 'extradr19' (rank 24, last activity 1 week ago).
items.handling: Labelled OWNER-REPORTED everywhere; no causal claim rests on the attribution alone.

items.finding: Two corrections to sibling write-ups (60GEMSDOE why-02778 note): the ladder is not nested at d1.5 -> d2.8 (d2.8 is a separate thinning), and the champion's minimum catalogue distance is 2.24 px with the last rung removing dots at 1.41 and 2.00 px (not 3.00 px / exactly 2.00 px).
GEMSDOE32 src/gems32/h33.py lidar_scarp_composite documents 0.45 ex_max + 0.35 step_max + 0.20 downface_max but reads band indices 1, 2, 5 (= ex_max, ex_mean, lappos_max).
items.handling: This lane selects lidar bands by description name (src/gems69/evidence.py). Not fixed upstream: GEMSDOE32 is not the shared template.

items.finding: All inputs come from the owner's GitHub mirrors because the DrivenData data tab is login-walled. SHA-256 pins prove mirror consistency, not organizer authentication.
items.handling: Pins listed in src/gems69/data.py and verified by scripts/restore_data.py; the feature mirror manifest records the organizer Dropbox links.

items.finding: geodawn_dem_a2_100m.tif (used only to infer dip polarity) has an x-origin of 243349.9656 m instead of 243350 m (0.034 m offset).

Cutting visible polylines at the withheld + 3 px collar mask creates artificial 'cut tips' next to withheld truth (254 in draw seed 20). Using them would leak the withheld location into the corridor generator.
items.handling: Cut tips are excluded from corridor generation in every holdout run (conservative; the live catalogue has no cut tips). Counted in evidence/e2_gate.json tip receipts.

items.finding: The catalogue hide-and-recover instrument measures how withheld catalogue components cluster around visible ones. A sibling measured its rank correlation with 12 owner-reported live scores at +0.14. Passing it is necessary, not sufficient, for a live gain.
items.handling: Gate decided on the instrument as pre-registered (A_corridor = 0.1347 vs B1_halo = 0.1264, delta = +0.0083 [+0.0039, +0.0123]); the limitation is stated in the run card and README, and promotion to a real slot remains a separate selector step.

items.finding: The live hidden-truth size |G| = 12,226 px used to set the live greedy bar is a model (GEMSDOE32 inversion of owner-reported scores), not an organizer number.
items.handling: Labelled [model]; it changes only how many dots the live build places (43,056), not the holdout verdict.

items.finding: The hard-linked-ramp masking test is weakly discriminating: masking a link turns its two attachment points into the very tips the generator pairs, so a random-azimuth line from the same tips already recovers ~70% of link pixels within 300 m.
items.handling: Reported with its null (0.9931 vs 0.6966 null mean; paired Wilcoxon p = 5.3e-8); not used as a gate.

items.finding: The uniqueness corpus is the owner's public GEMSDOE-family repositories (60GEMSDOE historical index unioned with a fresh HEAD scan), not an organizer registry; files never committed publicly cannot be checked.
items.handling: Scope stated in registry/registry_index_69.json and the run card.

items.finding: The GitHub token in an earlier sandbox session was transiently invalid around 01:55 UTC ('The github.com token in GH_TOKEN is no longer valid'; REST calls returned HTTP 403). It was valid again by 01:56 UTC.
items.handling: Registry fetch continued via anonymous git transport throughout; push / PR / merge performed after the token was valid again.

items.finding: 41% of in-footprint INGENIOUS records carry a usable DIPDIRECT; the rest have 'Unspecified' or blank.
items.handling: Dip polarity inferred from hanging-wall topography (lower side) where unrecorded; agreement with recorded dips 90.3% on 1,984 polylines (evidence/e1_first_test.json).

items.finding: The protocol's literal 70% / 3-px forward dot-overlap rule cannot discriminate against space-filling lattices and >= 80,000-dot blanket halos in the registry. Example: 13GEMSDOE r13-lattice-s5 (375,305 dots, 7.26% support, classified as a dot field by the template) covers 99.98% of all allowed cells within 3 px, and r14_union_tips10_lat6 covers 77.1% of the corridor band.
items.handling: Audited in evidence/e3_uniqueness.json with both readings side-by-side: across all 584 comparable-budget registry rasters (< 80,000 dots, up to 1.86x our 43,056-dot budget), worst forward 3-px overlap is 0.6971 <= 0.70 (0 firings), and all 87 literal firings are non-discriminating continuous surfaces or >= 80,000-dot blanket halos/lattices (reverse overlap <= 0.3128, Jaccard <= 0.0175). Vendor template not edited (no private fork).

items.finding: Tooling: in a blob-less partial clone, `git ls-tree -l` lazily downloads every blob to report sizes, which stalled the first registry scan on large repositories.
items.handling: scripts/fetch_registry.py lists HEAD trees with one REST git/trees call per repository instead; full scan of 862 rasters, 0 errors.

items.finding: Two codebase defects in prior branches: (a) in PR #6/7 (src/gems69/holdout69.py), computing offcat = distance_transform_edt(~ctx.grid.catalogue) > flank_px against the full catalogue instead of visible masked out 100.0% of withheld positive truth in build_holdout (collapsing holdout DTI to 0.0060 / 0.0021) and leaked the full catalogue into leakage_canary; (b) in PR #5 (f3568dd), running greedy allocation at 1-px resolution (tile_px=1) without normal-fault tip-splay / flank-relay breach extensions and with flat global shrinkage packed adjacent pixels inside the 300 m kernel (A_corridor = 0.0749 vs R_corridor_random = 0.1106).
items.handling: Fixed offcat and leakage_canary in src/gems69/holdout69.py to use visible; extended src/gems69/corridors.py (include_splays=True, max_partners=4); implemented 3-level hierarchical empirical-Bayes calibration (src/gems69/calibrate.py) and 300 m kernel-radius decimation (tile_px=3, src/gems69/pipeline.py). Re-ran E1, E2 (A_corridor = 0.1347 vs B1_halo = 0.1264, delta = +0.0083 [+0.0039, +0.0123], gate PASS), and E3 (43,056 dots).
